scope: Four scalar topologies, six constructions, two paired run seeds and three separate complete lattice epochs. Native full covariance copied unchanged; epochs, prescriptions and Jacobian modes are never pooled.
generation_strategy: in-process caller-driven generation, one compiler core
execution_policy: One sampling core per task, at most two tasks on distinct physical cores
variance_definition: Trace of finite complex estimator covariance; not pointwise variance
timing: Generation plus evaluator compilation excludes input/reference and serialization. Sampling excludes separately measured coordinate hashing; includes native contexts, precision-cache warm-up and coordinator work. Per-sector evaluator cost includes precision rescue but excludes mapping/allocation/caller overhead.
memory: Decimal bytes. Generation peak RSS includes the whole fixture/reference, generation, compilation and saving process, although its generation timer excludes fixture/reference work. Per-arm RSS is sampled at approximately 50ms plus /proc-enumeration latency. Combined campaign peak also includes its coordinator. Unobserved short-lived processes have null RSS, never zero; separate kernel high-water probes are identified explicitly.
limitations: Two seeds give descriptive spread, not confidence intervals for performance or calibrated uncertainty coverage. Common caps are causally admitted, not variance-optimized. Sunrise has no interior threshold. Missing or censored arms/epochs are not zero.

plan.authorization_pending: Root authorized launch after independent concrete plan PASS; foundation confirmed all pins and scope.
plan.protocol: symbolic endpoint IBP/coefficient_series width2; fixed/poly/sign × symbolic/dual; common cap .1/.03/.01/.003; two independent seeds; three distinct native1024/2048/4096×8 epochs; Kuo33002/Korobov3/package1024; no pooling
plan.preparation: native references/input gates, then first kite fixed-symbolic arm inside its normal120s allowance; failure censors remaining kite arms
plan.scope: single caller/one physical core per native task, max2 concurrent, no quiet-host requirement, no automatic retries or escalation
plan.timing: generation/serialization, fresh restore/bind/pilot, native context+sampling+hash measured separately; sampling includes native evaluator setup and precision warm-up; actual operational counters separate from covariance

post_link_documentation_only.scope: Reviewed reproduction documentation only; never included/read by native fixture code. Original build record preserved.
